faq_heading: New construction in Mission: your questions answered

faq.q: What counts as new construction on this page?
faq.a: Active MLS® listings in Mission where the board's age field is 0 or less: homes finished this year and homes listed before completion, in houses, townhomes and condos.

faq.q: Where are the newest homes in Mission?
faq.a: Over the past year the newest sold homes were duplexes in Mission BC: median build year 2025, 16 sales, median price $935,595.

faq.q: How fast do newer homes sell in Mission?
faq.a: The quickest group among the newer ones was townhomes in Mission-West: 14 days to sell at a median, closing at 98.8% of the list price.

blocks.text: What newer homes in Mission have sold for
The most recently built homes that sold in Mission from November 2025 to October 2026 were duplexes in Mission BC. Their median build year was 2025; 16 sold at a median of $935,595.

3 of 8 sub-area and home-type groups with 5 or more sales had a median build year of 2020 or later. The newest were Mission BC duplexes (built 2025), Mission-West townhomes (built 2022) and Mission BC townhomes (built 2020).

items.t: Mission BC duplexes: 16 sold at a median of $935,595 (middle half between $627,500 and $1,021,250), taking 19 days at 98.0% of the list price, with a median build year of 2025. The typical home had 4 bedrooms, it sold for about $399 per square foot and 6% of the sales closed over the list price.

In Mission-West, the 9 townhomes that sold had a median build year of 2022 and a median price of $685,000; the middle half closed between $675,000 and $692,000, after 14 days on the market at 98.8% of list. The typical home had 3 bedrooms, it sold for about $473 per square foot, strata fees were a median $401 a month and 11% of the sales closed over the list price.

55 townhomes sold in Mission BC at a median $679,000, built 2020 at the median. They took 30 days and closed at 98.6% of the list price, with the middle half between $630,000 and $709,900. The typical home had 3 bedrooms, it sold for about $436 per square foot, strata fees were a median $310 a month and 2% of the sales closed over the list price. The median moved from $690,000 (November to January) to $639,000 (August to October).

Mission BC condos: 33 sold at a median of $470,000 (middle half between $405,999 and $525,000), taking 33 days at 97.6% of the list price, with a median build year of 2007. The typical home had 2 bedrooms, it sold for about $489 per square foot, strata fees were a median $431 a month and 3% of the sales closed over the list price. The median moved from $505,000 (November to January) to $430,000 (August to October).

In Lake Errock, the 11 houses that sold had a median build year of 2007 and a median price of $865,000; the middle half closed between $710,000 and $977,500, after 102 days on the market at 95.3% of list. The typical home had 3 bedrooms, it sold for about $359 per square foot and 0% of the sales closed over the list price.

252 houses sold in Mission BC at a median $891,000, built 1991 at the median. They took 33 days and closed at 97.1% of the list price, with the middle half between $784,975 and $1,075,000. The typical home had 4 bedrooms, it sold for about $372 per square foot and 9% of the sales closed over the list price. The median moved from $965,000 (November to January) to $790,000 (August to October).

Hatzic houses: 27 sold at a median of $985,000 (middle half between $855,000 and $1,289,500), taking 29 days at 96.5% of the list price, with a median build year of 1981. The typical home had 4 bedrooms, it sold for about $444 per square foot and 4% of the sales closed over the list price.

blocks.text: Mission overall: what sold over the past year

items.t: Across Mission, 305 houses sold at a median of $905,000, with the middle half between $780,000 and $1,095,000. They took 35 days and closed at 97.0% of the list price, and the median build year was 1991. The typical house sat on a lot of about 7,060 square feet. The median moved from $970,000 (November to January) to $808,000 (August to October).

Mission townhomes over the past year: 65 sales, a median of $679,900, and a middle half from $635,000 to $709,900. The median home was built in 2021, took 25 days to sell and closed at 98.6% of list. Strata fees were a median $349 a month. The median moved from $687,500 (November to January) to $641,704 (August to October).

Across Mission, 36 condos sold at a median of $468,250, with the middle half between $400,000 and $519,750. They took 32 days and closed at 97.6% of the list price, and the median build year was 2006. Strata fees were a median $433 a month. The median moved from $492,500 (November to January) to $430,000 (August to October).

Mission duplexes over the past year: 17 sales, a median of $895,000, and a middle half from $640,000 to $1,015,000. The median home was built in 2025, took 21 days to sell and closed at 97.7% of list.

blocks.text: Planning and zoning notes for Mission

items.t: The City of Mission's small-scale multi-unit housing zoning was Zoning Amending Bylaw 6299-2024-5949(163), amending Zoning Bylaw 5949-2020. Council adopted it on July 17, 2024, at a special meeting by a vote of 4 to 2, after an adoption motion had been defeated 3 to 3 on July 15.
